caption: Maloja Pass, Bregaglia
composition: Maloja Pass looking west down the hairpins into Val Bregaglia · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Maloja Pass is the saddle where the road drops west in hairpins into Val Bregaglia, and the frame is that drop rather than the Engadin lakes. Maloja came into the municipality of Bregaglia with Stampa in 2010, and Chiavenna, over the Italian border, is not used. The Open-Meteo model is clear and cool, with a light breeze and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
